item.title: Canada caps certain bank fees and here's how much you can save
item.description: People in Canada no longer have to worry about being charged a hefty bank fee as a new government measure kicks in on Thursday, March 12.The federal government has implemented a cap on the fee that Canadian banks can charge for non-sufficient funds (NSF).Banks charge NSF fees when a cheque or pre-authorized debit (PAD) payment is declined due to insufficient funds, and the customer doesn't have overdraft protection.
